title: Move the Nocturne default accent to #B094FF

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-28: allow #B094FF in the theme contract; rewrite midnight accent test pins

detail: The Midnight (Nocturne) --th-accent in the editor contract moves from #A68BF2 to #B094FF. House of Fates stores its own accent (#B377AF) and is unchanged. The violet guard allows the hex in the contract file only, and the two accent pins in lib/theme/midnight.test.ts follow.

verify.evidence: Contract --th-accent reads #B094FF and lib/theme/midnight.test.ts and the violet-family probe pass.
